title: A reader finds the book in the FT Weekend three days after the list ran
summary: Goel leads the Middle East practice at Ryan and was reading the FT Weekend when he hit the year-end selection. He picked out two titles from it, and the other was Daniel Susskind on children and AI.
attribution_title: Leader, Middle East Practice at Ryan
blockquote: I came across its Best Books of 2026 selection. My reading list, already considerably longer than my reading speed, has just grown a little more.
